title: mode.json
description: A session mode (S1): a named preset of the four axes. One folder for each mode in templates/modes/. A spec can set one axis to change one value of a preset.

name.description: The mode. It must be the same as the folder name.

interaction.description: task: one report when the check passes. stepwise: a report after each step, with no confirmation. conversation: ends when the user or the parent says done.

autonomy.description: auto: asks only a high-risk question. ask: asks each question that the policy does not answer. approve: waits for an approval before each step and before done.

route.description: Where the questions go: to the parent, or to the session chat.

visibility.description: public: import into the app and Remote Control on, at the earliest point. private: neither.

describe.description: One sentence: when to use the mode.
